title: Ramp to the Roof
brief: Sacks go up to roof storage, 1.2 m up: 6 carriers, 2 trolleys, a wheelchair sevadar and an elderly visitor. Everyone gets up. Budget ₹20,000.

mistri.brief: Bori bhi upar jaayegi, wheelchair bhi. Jagah dekh ke banana.

hints.NO_ACCESSIBLE_ROUTE: Seedhi sab ke liye nahi hoti, puttar.
hints.RAMP_TOO_STEEP: Wheelchair kitni chadhai le sakti hai? Pehle naapo.
hints.TROLLEY_ROLLBACK: Bhaari trolley dheemi dhalaan maangti hai.
hints.TIGHT_TURN: Mudne ke liye poori jagah chahiye, kone mein nahi.
hints.NO_REST_LANDING: Lamba ramp? Beech mein saans lene do.
hints.NO_PATH: Zameen se chhat tak raasta judna chahiye.
hints.TIME_LIMIT: Dekho kaun sabse dheere chal raha hai, aur kyon.
hints.default: Pehle naapo: kitna lamba ramp chahiye, kitni jagah hai?

insight.title: Accessible design needs space, so plan it first.
insight.principle: A ramp gentle enough for a wheelchair is long. Fold it into a switchback with landings, and give it its space before anything else is built.
insight.example: Well-planned stations and hospitals draw their ramps first. Ramps squeezed in later end up too steep or too tight to turn.
insight.number: 1.2 m up at 1:12 takes 14.4 m of ramp, with a flat landing at least every 9 m.
insight.quote: Ramp baad mein nahi, pehle socho, puttar.
